This first second post-arrest application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail, who is behind the bars since 01.06.2022 in connection with Crime No.158/2022 registered at Police Station Khamariya, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(D), 376(2) of IPC.

As per the portrayal of prosecution story, the applicant in connivance with main accused, who is her husband has managed to call the prosecutrix at a place, where the main accused committed rape with her.

Learned counsel for the applicant sanguinely submits that the only allegation against the applicant is that she mischievously called the prosecutrix to come to a certain place, where co-accused has committed rape with her.

She further submits that looking to the limited role of the applicant and Meera Bai Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3262095/
1 the fact that she is a lady and is incarcerated since long, she may be granted bail.
I

sentences.text: , learned counsel for the State opposes the application and prays for its dismissal inasmuch as the prosecution story itself drifts the fact to the surface that the applicant was instrumental for organizing the crime and on her instigation, prosecutrix came and the co-accused who had already chalked out a plan of committing rape, has executed the plan.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary and particularly the fact that the applicant is a lady and is in prison since 01.06.2022, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
However, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance on the dates given by it.

I t is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Sudesh Meera Bai Thakur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3262095/
